summary: Backend (11/11 pytest passed) and frontend (Playwright) end-to-end testing completed for Devishiv Hospital website. All critical flows verified: home/header/footer, navigation across pages, doctors list and credentials, services tabs (Clinical/Diagnostic/Allied), Google Maps iframe on Contact, contact form submission persisting to MongoDB with success toast, and full appointment booking with doctor preselect via ?doctor= query param, calendar date picker, time slot selection, success screen and reference ID. POST /api/contact and POST /api/appointments are integrated correctly. One minor data-testid mismatch found on Services page.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='services-tabs' wrapper not present on the Tabs root; sub-tabs tab-clinical/tab-diagnostic/tab-allied are present and switch correctly. Minor; only impacts test selectors.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='services-tabs' to the <Tabs> root on /services for consistency with test plan; sub-tabs already work.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores datetime as ISO string on insert and reconverts on GET — works correctly and avoids ObjectId serialization (no _id leakage).
EmailStr validation is enforced in Pydantic — invalid emails correctly return 422.
Appointment date is stored as string YYYY-MM-DD — consider validating with a regex/date type to reject malformed dates (currently any string accepted).
No rate limiting or captcha on /api/contact and /api/appointments — acceptable for MVP but worth noting for production.
CORS uses wildcard by default — fine for preview; restrict in prod.
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed records created in MongoDB: contact_messages and appointments collections (used for E2E verification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 11 tests, all pass). For the Appointment page, the doctor and time-slot Selects are shadcn (BUTTON triggers with role=option items); use page.get_by_role('option', name=...) — not native select_option. Calendar uses RDP with selector button[name='day']:not([disabled]). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL = https://care-hub-lucknow.preview.emergentagent.com.
